pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions. Edges exhibit smooth to moderately sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the mid-flank and reduces significantly in size and connectivity toward the lower neck and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pixel thickness varies, with notable constriction between larger flank patches and relative widening at intersections.
